Infinite scroll and Load more without duplicates
Card opens detail page; Back returns to list
Header search with scope (All -> /find, Wallpapers -> ?keyword), View all
Search edge cases: no results + suggestions, special chars, empty submit, Cancel
Sort by: options, URL key, chip, order invariants
Price filter: Free/Paid and From/To range
Color filter (multi-select)
Category filter (multi-select)
Tag combobox filter
Filter state: chips, chip removal, Reset All, combinations, deep link/Back
Content-type switch (Wallpapers/Ringtones/Notification Sounds/Artists)
Category navigation: header Categories menu, Explore block, /category pages
Detail page content: title, artist, date, downloads, Premium/price, keyword chips, Related
Free download: Preparing countdown dialog and real image file
Premium gates (Buy for modal, Unlock modal), close/Escape, no file leak
Share dialog

Guest header and footer

findings.text: 06-detail.spec.ts:29 asserts that the first ?free=true card has no 'Premium' label; live, 11/24 free cards carry a Premium crown, so the result depends on live data.
08-premium-gate.spec.ts:39-53,89-95 treats price-10 premium showing Download as normal and walks past it, hiding ZED-3.

Weak checks: empty search only checks main is visible (04-search.spec.ts:93-99), malformed id only checks <500 (06-detail.spec.ts:86), multi-category only checks the list differs (02-filters.spec.ts:56).
No tags (@smoke/@regression) on any test.
Fixed sleep page.waitForTimeout(1500) in 08-premium-gate.spec.ts:63.
Run-time test.skip and if-loops in tests: 03-sorting.spec.ts:88, 04-search.spec.ts:108, 06-detail.spec.ts:67, 08-premium-gate.spec.ts:44.
BUG-002 test combines test.fail with a self-skip when data is ordered (03-sorting.spec.ts:81-88); it can skip silently instead of signalling a fix.
Hydration is detected through React private __reactProps keys (helper.ts:58-62, header.component.ts:21-23).
Card price parsing is copied in wallpaper-feed.page.ts:192 and helpers.ts:48 and :67; data pickers live in a test helper instead of a page object.
WallpaperFeedPage (211 lines) holds feed, filters, sort, chips and scroll with no components.
No Share dialog, From/To price range, Load more, content-type switch; the Buy-for modal is never opened.

bugs.claim: BUG-002 Newest first is not ordered by publish date
BUG-003 '%' in search makes the client loop on URIError

findings.text: Card invariants rely on class/style fragments: div[class*="card-footer"], .bg-cover, div[class*="card-header"] [style*="premium"] (CardGrid.ts:61,98; CardLinkValidator.ts:23-28); img.object-cover (WallpaperDetailPage.ts:29).
Filter and sort results are proven only by 'first 3 hrefs differ' (CardGrid.ts:50-54); nothing checks result content, and the check can fail when two sorts share their top items.
validatePremiumPrice asserts Buy and no Download, but price 10 is excluded on purpose (wallpapers-purchase.spec.ts:3), so ZED-3 cannot surface.
WallpapersListPage.open waits for the exact marketing H1 'download hd phone wallpapers for free' (WallpapersListPage.ts:35).
No Unlock/'Login & Watch Ad' gate, SEO, narrow layout, invalid-param or '%' search, newest-first order, chip removal or browser Back.
TKT-6 has no @BUG regression test; observed defects (sort=BOGUS 500, ZED-3, dialog console error) were left as plan notes.
Price-badge parsing is duplicated in CardGrid.prices and CardLinkValidator; LOAD_TIMEOUT is defined in two files.
Ticket files are named WPR-* but hold TKT-* keys; ticket statuses are stale.

bugs.claim: TKT-6 Price filter with only From puts maxPrice=NaN in the URL

findings.text: Class fragments, positions and XPath: nav[class*='header_nav'], div[class*="Modal_modal"].nth(1), div.heading-xl, span.body-lg, div[class*="CardsContainer"], a[class*="A_link"], (//main//h1/following-sibling::div/div)[2]/button[1], buyBtn .nth(1), button[arial-role="combobox"] (depends on a markup typo).

Four copy-pasted filterByX and three isXSelected methods in FiltersBar.ts; WallpapersListPage extends HeaderPage (296 lines) with pass-through wrappers; file and class names differ (BodyHeaderPage, ModalBuyPage).
Search requires every query word ('messi', 'city tower car') to appear in some live card label (wallpapers-search.spec.ts:12-23).
Checks that cannot fail: toHaveText('') on an input (HeaderPage.ts:150) and branching on an input's innerText (HeaderPage.ts:63-68).
The plan claims Category is single-select, but live it is multi-select; the narrow test's /NATURE/ check cannot tell the two apart.
Download writes to a shared downloads/ folder cleared in beforeAll and polls with setTimeout (DownloadFlow.ts:15-28); parallel workers collide.
Bug tests pin specific production GUIDs and titles (wallpapers-purchase.spec.ts:112,133).

Branching helpers and loops in spec files (applyFilter switch, pickPaidCardSkippingTen, closePurchaseModal); console.log and commented code in page objects; mega-tests WP-02 (9 searches) and WP-35 (9 steps).
No 404 or invalid-param tests, no Share, no SEO, no newest or ascending order check, no file-type check on the download.
